0002f266.evidence: Mask-0x10 fan task: pool 0x2f29c=0x2f51a, 0x2f2a0=0x2f65c, 0x2f2a4=0x2f1dc (words read from ROM; jsr at 0x2f276/0x2f27c/0x2f282); called from 0x117ac via pool 0x11a04 (load at 0x11826). Runs low-speed decision, high-speed decision, then the GPIO output.

0002f51a.evidence: Low-speed (fan 1) command 0xffffbda1: coolant hysteresis 94/97 C -> 0xffffbdaa/0xffffbdab; bda1 = 1 when (bdaa || (bdab && 0xffffb0cd)) || (engine stopped 0xffffaa68==0 && 0xffffbda0 && !0xffffccc6 && !0xffffa8ea && !0xffffbf8d) || (0xffffbd68 || 0xffffbd6a), gated by fault flags 0xffffd040/0xffffd0a8/0xffffd264/0xffffd269/0xffffd263. Reads bda1 via pool 0x2f63a at 0x2f58a.

0002f65c.evidence: High-speed (fan 2) command 0xffffbda2: coolant 98/101 C -> 0xffffbdac; load 0xffffc6ac 1.84/1.94 -> 0xffffbdb2; coolant 77/80 C -> 0xffffbdb3; vspeed 8/10 km/h -> 0xffffbdb4; bda2 = 1 when bda1==1 && counter 0xffffbda8 > 0x5c && (bdac || (bd68 && A/C switch bdb8) || (engine stopped && bda0 && !ccc6 && !a8ea && !bf8d) || bd6a || (bdb2==0 && bdb3 && !bdb4)) || 0xffffc5e6 || (d264 && !d269), gated by d263; bda8 counts up while bda1 (saturating u16).

0002f1dc.evidence: Fan relay GPIO output: PEDR_W 0xfffff754 bit 0x800 (PE11, SH7055F pkg pin 21) from 0x5c724(0xffffbda1) and bit 0x10 (PE4, pkg pin 12) from 0x5c648(0xffffbda2), each via ref_setRegister_REG_BIT_VAL 0x4bbc under mask 0xe0 (ref_setSR_PARAM 0x2054). Pool words: 0x2f240=0xf754, 0x2f242=0x800, 0x2f244=0xbda1, 0x2f246=0x10, 0x2f248=0xbda2, 0x2f24c=0x2054, 0x2f250=0x4bbc, 0x2f254=0x2064, 0x2f258=0x5c724, 0x2f25c=0x5c648. PEDR_W at symbols.tsv 0xfffff754. Harness terminals: cooling fan relay 5X/5AD (pinout v3).

0002f188.evidence: Same two PEDR_W 0xfffff754 bits (0x800 PE11 / 0x10 PE4) written directly from 0xffffbda1/0xffffbda2 without diag arbitration (pool 0x2f240-0x2f25c shared with 0x2f1dc, jsr @r13 = 0x4bbc at 0x2f1aa); reached via thunk 0x2f260 from the init fan-out 0x1102a (callgraph 0x1102a -> 0x2f260). Inherited ref_initFanControl name confirmed as init-time output writer.

0002f260.evidence: 4-byte thunk to 0x2f188; called from init fan-out 0x1102a.

0005c724.evidence: UDS actuator-test arbitration for fan 1: DID 0x17c3 (mask 0xc0 on 0xffffd36c, state 0xffffd319/0xffffd323, output cell 0xffffd345); result feeds 0x2f1dc's PE11 write.

0005c648.evidence: UDS actuator-test arbitration for fan 2: DID 0x17c4; result feeds 0x2f1dc's PE4 write.

ffffbda1.evidence: Fan 1 (low-speed relay) command computed by 0x2f51a (coolant 94/97 C hysteresis, engine-off/APV/SSV and A/C conditions, DTC gates); written to PEDR_W 0xfffff754 bit 0x800 (PE11) by 0x2f188/0x2f1dc via diag override 0x5c724.

ffffbda2.evidence: Fan 2 (high-speed relay) command computed by 0x2f65c (needs bda1 && counter bda8 > 0x5c plus coolant 98/101 C / load / vspeed / A/C conditions); written to PEDR_W bit 0x10 (PE4) by 0x2f188/0x2f1dc via diag override 0x5c648.

ffffbda8.evidence: Saturating counter (rx8_add_u16_saturate) incremented while 0xffffbda1==1, cleared otherwise (0x2f65c); high-speed fan 2 requires bda8 > 0x5c (92 counts).
